recipe.visualDefinition: A symmetrical, close-up portrait of a woman with a pale, airbrushed complexion, featuring four large metallic needles or acupuncture-style bolts horizontally piercing through her face and neck. The subject wears a detailed biomechanical headband with a central circular jewel. The background consists of dark, stormy clouds illuminated by white lightning bolts.
coreVisualRelationships: Horizontal needles contrasting with the vertical symmetry of the face
Metallic, industrial hardware against soft, organic skin textures
High-contrast lightning bolts framing the dark silhouette of the head
Mechanical headband acting as a crown-like visual anchor
coreInvariants: Four horizontal needles piercing the face symmetrically
Biomechanical headband with intricate circuitry-like textures
Direct, neutral gaze of the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered, large-scale bust portrait filling the majority of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central circular element of the headband located on the forehead.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes lead to the headband, then follow the horizontal needles outward to the edges of the frame, finally settling on the lightning in the background.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the head and needles occupy most of the canvas, with lightning filling the remaining corners.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated, pale flesh tones and cool greys for the skin and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks in the hair and shadows for depth.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Metallic bronze/gold for the headband and needles; subtle pinkish-red vertical line on the forehead.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the lightning and the dark clouds.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain a muted, almost monochromatic sepia-toned palette

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: High-contrast, elegant serif and sans-serif mix.
letterConstructionRules: Tall x-heights for the secondary text
Horizontal rule line underlining the primary display text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Interlocking 'OO' characters in the secondary title
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A thin, uppercase serif paired with a slightly more geometric, lowercase-heavy sans-serif for a modern-classical contrast.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the elegant, high-contrast feel of the display text.
Matches the sharp serifs and verticality.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a centered, airbrushed surrealist portrait of a woman with pale skin and dark hair. Include a detailed biomechanical headband and four large horizontal needles piercing her cheeks and neck. The background should be dark clouds with white lightning bolts.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add thin, elegant, right-aligned black text in the top right corner. Use a light serif for the top line, a horizontal rule below it, and a stylized sans-serif for the second line.

verificationChecks: Ensure the needles are perfectly horizontal and symmetrical.
Check that the lightning does not obscure the facial features.
Verify the biomechanical headband has a 'giger-esque' mechanical texture.
Confirm the typography is thin and does not dominate the visual space.

mustRedesign: Specific facial likeness of the original subject
Any existing artist signatures or logos
postGenerationChecks: Are there exactly four needles piercing the face/neck?
Is the headband centered on the forehead?
Does the background feature distinct lightning bolts?
Is the overall mood somber and surreal?
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Surrealist Portraiture] + [Biomechanical Elements] + [Atmospheric Weather Background] with [Minimalist High-Contrast Typography] for a dark, avant-garde aesthetic.
